comparison.objective: Secure a gas cylinder before removing its valve cap; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Installing a restraint and removing a cap in safe order versus coaxial mandrel alignment, stabilized hammering, careful withdrawal, and tiny-part collection.
comparison.success_condition: Cylinder remains upright and strapped before cap removal, with cap placed in tray versus four fractures and four contained tangs without shell or coil damage.
comparison.reason: Both penalize unsafe ordering or damage, but they test different physical abilities and terminal states. No separate spec versions were provided.
